title: Verdict
description: The codomain of the markdown-document's `conforming/` morphism: a conformance verdict that IS a settled sheaf section. The verdict is not asserted; it is read off voidmath's glued section. A MUST whose settled charge is negative is an undrained obstruction (non-conformant — residue did not drain to zero, H^1 != 0); a SHOULD negative drains but leaves a noted shadow; a MAY never obstructs. `conformant` therefore mirrors voidmath's H^1 = 0: the descent settled with no MUST obstruction surviving. Mirror of voidmath's `sheaf` (the settle-codomain), specialized to a conformance fiber algebra.

settled.description: Whether the conformance descent reached its fixed point (the section glued). True for any well-formed charge set; the modal reading then decides conformance.

conformant.description: True iff no MUST predicate's settled charge is negative — the cohomological reading of conformance (H^1 = 0, no surviving obstruction).

notes.description: The noted-but-non-blocking shadows: each SHOULD predicate whose settled charge is negative. Drained obstructions that do not block gluing.

section.description: The glued global section the verdict is read off: voidmath's fixed-point valuation, charge-valued per cell. The conformance verdict IS this section, not a claim about it.
